SELECT ROUND(AVG(ABS(bt.predicted_kwh - bt.actual_kwh) / bt.actual_kwh) * 100, 2) AS MAPE FROM backtest bt JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = bt.region_id
WHERE rg.region_name = #{regionName}

SELECT rg.short_name AS SHORT_NAME , rg.region_name AS REGION_NAME , fc.year AS DATA_YEAR , fc.month AS DATA_MONTH , ROUND((fc.predicted_kwh / fc.prev_year_kwh - 1) * 100, 1) AS YOY_PCT FROM forecast fc JOIN region rg ON rg.region_id = fc.region_id JOIN (SELECT year AS y, month AS m FROM forecast ORDER BY year, month LIMIT 1) first ON fc.year = first.y AND fc.month = first.m ORDER BY YOY_PCT DESC, rg.short_name
SELECT region_name AS REGION_NAME , short_name AS SHORT_NAME FROM region ORDER BY region_id
